title: Support explicit numeric primary sort keys
result: Read declarations and legacy text atomically; accept one rendered finite decimal declaration and preserve existing parsing for every rejected or absent declaration. Count ties keep their meaning without choosing a first line heuristically. Consumer adoption stays a separate partial task.
evidence: Original `pnpm run build` and `pnpm run test` passed 531 tests in 130 files on the combined sticky and numeric candidate. Coverage was 97.01% statements, 92.35% branches, 95.70% functions and 98.30% lines against unchanged thresholds. Full native TypeScript and ESLint passed after correcting a fixture parameter-count violation; the failed first static run is retained. Pure and real DOM zero-area controls pass. Final actual bytes, modes and deletion match the 26-path frozen manifest; README permission normalization changed no tested bytes. No consumer adoption, release or deployment occurred.
